# Copilot instructions

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. It is the single source of truth for architecture, commands, conventions, folder rules, the definition of done, and the workflow loop.

Key points: feature modules under `src/modules/*`, routes only in `src/app`, colours only from theme tokens, `pnpm verify` must pass, conventional commits.

For UI work, follow [design principles](../docs/design-principles.md) and complete [the UI checklist](../docs/ui-checklist.md).
